points.description: Defines trap efficiency as the ratio/proportion/percentage of sediment deposited (trapped) in the reservoir to the total sediment inflow (over a given period/life of the reservoir).
points.partial_credit: Half mark if only says it is the sediment trapped/retained by the reservoir, without the ratio to inflow.

points.description: Lists factors affecting trap efficiency, e.g. size/diameter of silt particles, type/size/weight of debris, shape of the dam, topography, dam material, wind/flow direction. About three of these (or clear equivalents) earn full marks.
points.partial_credit: Half mark for one or two valid factors.

rubric.notes: Full marks: the definition as a ratio of deposited sediment to total inflow, plus about three valid factors from the model answer in any wording. Part marks: a vague definition (sediment trapped in the reservoir) or only one or two factors. No marks for wrong or unrelated answers; extra remarks do not lose marks.
